title: Loring v. City of Boston — an old reward
shortTitle: Loring v. City of Boston — an old reward
summary: A reward advertised during an emergency was held no longer open several years later.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The discussion considers the purpose and publicity of the reward, changed circumstances, and the lapse of roughly three and a half years. The continuing reward in Carr presents a different temporal purpose.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 239–240. Open assigned page 239.
